review:
Beast Band is a 25-line music slot starring a five-piece animal rock band. VIP concert tickets are the scatters, and three on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger eight free spins in which low-paying symbols are removed, so only premium symbols land.

Retriggers are unlimited. A second feature uses CD symbols: six or more disks trigger a separate bonus game. The wild substitutes for everything except scatters and disks. BGaming rates the game medium-high volatility with a 7,500x maximum, and the 96.88% RTP is strong. Having two separate bonus routes keeps sessions varied, and the free spins with only high symbols can deliver big line wins.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
